title: Tier 1 allowed to apply for virtual card
description: Verifies that a Tier 1 (email-verified) user can access and submit the virtual prepaid card application without being blocked by tier restrictions, ensuring correct role-based access for virtual card issuance. Automation: HIGH — UI/API happy path.
testDescription: A registered Tier 1 user signs in, navigates to the Virtual Card Application screen, and submits an application for a new virtual prepaid card. The system accepts the application and displays a confirmation, demonstrating that Tier 1 users are allowed to apply per requirements.
prerequisites:
EvolvePay v1.5 test environment is available and healthy
A Tier 1 user account exists (email-verified, not KYC-verified), credentials provisioned
No active user session prior to test start
ASSUMPTION: Test account does not already have a virtual card; environment permits issuance on demand
stepsToPerform:
1) Open the EvolvePay app/web and navigate to the Login screen; observe the login form is displayed.
2) Enter Tier 1 credentials (email: test+t1@example.com, password: ********) and submit; verify successful login to the home/dashboard.
3) Navigate to Profile; verify verification status explicitly shows "Tier 1" to confirm the user's tier.
4) From the main menu, open Prepaid Card Management and select "Apply for a new virtual prepaid card"; verify the Virtual Card Application screen is displayed.
5) Verify the "Apply"/"Submit" action for a virtual prepaid card is visible and enabled for this Tier 1 user.
6) Click the "Apply"/"Submit" action; verify the app sends the request and shows in-progress feedback (e.g., spinner/progress) until completion.
7) Observe a confirmation on completion indicating the virtual card application was accepted (e.g., confirmation screen/banner visible).
8) Navigate to the Card Details area from the app menu and open the newly created virtual card; verify the Card Details screen loads for the virtual card.
9) On the Card Details screen, verify the presence of a "current balance" field label to confirm the card object is accessible (no need to assert specific values).
10) Log out; verify the session ends and the login screen is shown.
expectedResult:
- The Virtual Card Application action is accessible and enabled for a Tier 1 user; no tier-based block is shown.
- Submission completes and a confirmation is displayed indicating the application was accepted.
- A virtual card is accessible to the user, evidenced by successful navigation to its Card Details screen (with a current balance label visible).

sourceCitation.excerpt: As a registered user (Tier 1 or Tier 2), I want to apply for a new virtual prepaid card so I can start making online purchases immediately.

uiScreen: Virtual Card Application, Profile, Card Details
assumptions: ASSUMPTION: UI control labels may vary slightly (e.g., Apply/Submit); confirmation has generic success indicator without a mandated message text.
riskNotes: Validates role/tier-based access in a financial context; incorrect gating could violate business rules and user entitlements.
regulatoryNotes: Tiering derives from AML/KYC model; this test ensures permitted access for Tier 1 is not improperly restricted.
